content.body: What's the plan for the tests?
I ran these tests in Firefox and Chrome and took the values that they reported.

GitHub has an interesting new feature when blocking users, but unfortunately it doesn't work for security issues:

> [ ] Close all open issues, pull requests, and discussions opened by this user

And that's really the only time I get to this checkbox as otherwise I don't need to go all the way to the settings panel of the org.
